SHAP Feature Importance (Normal Class)
Key Insights
Dom_Freq
Top predictor — fault type shifts the dominant vibration frequency due to bearing geometry interaction.
P2P
Peak-to-peak amplitude captures severity — larger cracks produce wider vibration swings.
RMS & Peak
Energy-based features strongly indicate Ball faults at different severity levels.
FFT Features
FFT_Std and FFT_Mean capture spectral spread — faults create concentrated energy spikes vs Normal's flat spectrum.

Feature ranking:
🏉 Dom_Freq   🏊 P2P   🏋 Peak   4. RMS   5. FFT_Std   6. FFT_Mean   7. Crest   8. FFT_Peak   9. Mean   10. Std
